verdict.rationale: LiveKit's docs say you can build voice agents in code with Python or Node.js and connect them to web or mobile apps, which implies official language SDKs, but the pack never names or lists the SDKs. A community member wished for a Rust desktop client SDK, which suggests SDK coverage has gaps; the CLI supports scaffolding agents alongside the code path. Missing for 10: an explicit list of official SDKs per language/platform, SDK reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence of Rust/desktop client SDK coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
